lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is tighter in the mid-section and wider at the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible abbreviated line segments; a short dash is present near the anterior shoulder region and two fragmented lines terminate mid-flank on the posterior side.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots located on the upper and mid-posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align in a diagonal vector trending toward the rear leg.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped chevron across the nasal bridge; large white patch on the ventral neck/throat region; white banding visible on the lower section of all visible limbs.
